build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized bar positions, angles, and wall distances
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with a given scale and position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable angle, scale, and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task goal to require two bodies to be touching each other
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to mark the solution tier as BALL type
